title: AskHPC: A ChatBot for High Performance Computing User Support
problem: Exascale HPC systems are increasingly heterogeneous with complex tools, configurations, and best practices. Documentation is scattered across multimodal sources. Users struggle to find accurate information efficiently.
motivation: HPC users waste time navigating fragmented documentation. Need centralized, intelligent interface to HPC knowledge. LLMs+RAG can help but require careful design for technical accuracy.
method: LLM-based chatbot (AskHPC) with curated knowledge base and RAG framework. Dual-context strategy: retrieved content (e.g., code blocks) + LLM-generated semantics. Modality-aware document parsing for multimodal sources. Real user study evaluation.
key_novelty: Modality-aware document parsing preserving structure; dual-context RAG strategy combining retrieval with semantic generation; end-to-end evaluation with real users.
contributions: Curated knowledge base for HPC (user guides, manuals, documentation)
Modality-aware document parsing for multimodal HPC documentation
Outperforms direct LLM queries and vanilla RAG

metrics.accuracy: Outperforms direct LLM and vanilla RAG

limitations: Abstract only; specific accuracy metrics not provided; user study size/scope unclear; scalability to evolving documentation not discussed.
